# Spencer Alexander Lawyers

Last updated: 5 September 2026.

> A Melbourne, Victoria (Australia) law firm practising Family Law, Wills & Estates and Commercial Law, acting for individuals, families and businesses across Victoria. Clients speak directly with the principal, Spencer Alexander, and receive a written fee estimate before work begins. Located at Suite 10, 1 Main Street, Box Hill VIC 3128. Phone (03) 9125 8355. Hours Mon-Fri 8am-6pm. Liability limited by a scheme approved under Professional Standards Legislation.

This file helps AI systems locate and correctly attribute our published legal guidance. All articles are general legal information about Victorian and Australian law, not legal advice, and are written by Spencer Alexander, Principal (LLB Hons Monash; LLM University of Sydney; GDLP College of Law).

## Free resources and checklists

- [Separation in Victoria: your first 30 days](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/resource-separation-first-30-days.html): Published 25 August 2026. A practical checklist for the first 30 days after separating in Victoria: safety, finances, the children, your will and power of attorney, and the deadlines to diarise.

## Wills & Estates articles

- [Fraudulent calumny in Victoria: can a lie invalidate a will?](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-fraudulent-calumny-victoria.html): Published 24 August 2026. Fraudulent calumny is emerging as a ground to challenge a will in Victoria, where deliberate lies shaped what the will maker decided. What it means and how to respond.
- [Advance care directives in Victoria: who decides if you cannot](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-advance-care-directives-victoria.html): Published 10 August 2026. How advance care directives work in Victoria: instructional and values directives, appointing a medical treatment decision maker, and who decides if you have not.
- [Guardianship and administration orders in Victoria: what happens without a power of attorney](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-guardianship-administration-orders.html): Published 27 July 2026. When someone loses capacity without an enduring power of attorney, VCAT can appoint a guardian or administrator. Here is how the process works in Victoria.
- [What happens if you die without a will in Victoria?](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-dying-without-a-will.html): Published 6 July 2026. Victoria's intestacy rules decide everything if you die without a will: what a partner receives, children from other relationships, letters of administration, and who inherits when.
- [Contesting a will in Victoria: your rights and the time limits](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-contesting-a-will.html): Published 15 June 2026. Left out of a will or treated unfairly? Who can bring a Part IV family provision claim in Victoria, what the court weighs, the strict six-month deadline, costs, and defending an estate.
- [Superannuation death benefits: why your super does not follow your will](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-superannuation-death-benefits.html): Published 8 June 2026. Who receives your superannuation when you die: binding death benefit nominations, SIS dependants, tax on adult children, SMSF risks, and how to align super with your estate plan.
- [Testamentary trusts: protecting an inheritance in Victoria](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-testamentary-trusts.html): Published 25 May 2026. How testamentary trusts work in wills: asset protection from bankruptcy and relationship breakdown, tax-effective income for children, blended families, and when the cost is worth it.
- [An executor's duties in Victoria: the complete checklist](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-executor-duties.html): Published 4 May 2026. What an executor must actually do in Victoria: securing assets, probate, debts and tax, the six-month rule, estate accounts, personal liability, and when to renounce or get help.
- [Enduring powers of attorney in Victoria: who needs one and how they work](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-enduring-powers-of-attorney.html): Published 20 April 2026. How enduring powers of attorney work in Victoria: financial and personal matters, choosing an attorney, witnessing rules, medical treatment decision makers, and VCAT safeguards.
- [Probate in Victoria: a step-by-step guide for executors and families](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-probate-victoria.html): Published 30 March 2026. What probate is, when a grant is required in Victoria, the steps from advertising to distribution, how long it takes, the costs, and what executors are personally responsible for.
- [How to make a valid will in Victoria: requirements, witnesses and common mistakes](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-making-a-valid-will.html): Published 16 March 2026. What makes a will legally valid in Victoria: the signing and witnessing rules, who can make one, what a will can and cannot control, and the mistakes that cause disputes.

## Family Law articles

- [Grandparents' rights in Victoria: can you apply to see your grandchildren?](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-grandparents-rights-victoria.html): Published 31 August 2026. Grandparents have no automatic right to see their grandchildren, but the Family Law Act lets them apply. How grandparents rights actually work, and what to do first.
- [Spousal maintenance in Victoria: when you can claim support from a former partner](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-spousal-maintenance-victoria.html): Published 13 August 2026. Who can claim spousal maintenance in Victoria, the needs and capacity test, time limits after divorce or separation, and how it differs from property settlement.
- [How is child support calculated in Australia?](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-child-support-australia.html): Published 3 August 2026. How Services Australia calculates child support: the formula, care percentages, changing an unfair assessment, objections, agreements and the 2026 reforms.
- [How is property divided after separation?](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-property-after-separation.html): Published 13 July 2026. How Australian courts divide property after separation: the four-step framework, contributions and future needs, superannuation splitting, time limits, and consent orders that bind.
- [Intervention orders in Victoria: protection, process and your options](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-intervention-orders.html): Published 29 June 2026. How family violence intervention orders work in Victoria: police and private applications, interim orders, conditions, breaches, responding to an order, and links to family law.
- [De facto separation in Victoria: your property and parenting rights](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-de-facto-separation.html): Published 18 May 2026. De facto couples in Victoria have near-identical rights to married couples: the two-year threshold, registered relationships, the two-year time limit, super splitting and parenting.
- [Binding financial agreements in Australia: prenups that actually hold](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-binding-financial-agreements.html): Published 27 April 2026. How binding financial agreements work: before, during or after a relationship, the independent legal advice rules, when courts set them aside, and how BFAs compare with consent orders.
- [Parenting arrangements after separation: how the law decides what is best](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-parenting-arrangements.html): Published 13 April 2026. How parenting works after separation under Australia's updated framework: the best-interests factors, parenting plans versus consent orders, mediation requirements, and urgent cases.
- [Getting divorced in Victoria: the process, the 12-month rule and what happens next](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-divorce-in-victoria.html): Published 23 March 2026. How divorce works for Victorians: the 12-month separation rule, separation under one roof, sole and joint applications, costs, children requirements, and the property deadline after divorce.
- [The 2025 family law property reforms: what separating couples need to know](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-property-reforms-2025.html): Published 9 March 2026. The Family Law Amendment Act 2024 changed property settlements from June 2025: a codified four-step framework, family violence recognised economically, pets, wastage and disclosure duties.

## Commercial Law articles

- [Director's duties in Victoria: what every business owner must know](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-directors-duties-victoria.html): Published 17 August 2026. The legal duties every company director must meet in Victoria: care and diligence, good faith, avoiding conflicts of interest, and preventing insolvent trading.
- [Buying a business in Victoria: what to check before you sign](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-buying-a-business-victoria.html): Published 6 August 2026. The legal checklist for buying a business in Victoria: due diligence, section 52 statements, the contract of sale, lease transfers, staff entitlements and GST.
- [The contracts every Victorian business should have](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-contracts-for-business.html): Published 20 July 2026. The written agreements that prevent commercial disputes: terms of trade, employment contracts, shareholder agreements, leases, supplier terms, privacy policies and personal guarantees.
- [Recovering unpaid debts in Victoria: from letter of demand to statutory demand](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-debt-recovery-victoria.html): Published 22 June 2026. A practical guide to debt recovery in Victoria: letters of demand, which court to sue in, default judgment, enforcement warrants and garnishees, statutory demands and bankruptcy notices.
- [Retail leases in Victoria: what tenants must check before signing](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-retail-leases-victoria.html): Published 1 June 2026. Victoria's Retail Leases Act gives tenants real protections: disclosure statements, the five-year minimum, land tax bans, outgoings rules, options, make-good and VSBC dispute resolution.
- [Shareholder agreements: the document that saves business partnerships](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-shareholder-agreements.html): Published 11 May 2026. What a shareholder agreement covers and why co-owned companies need one: decisions, deadlock, exits and valuation, drag and tag rights, restraints, and the cost of not having one.
- [Choosing a business structure in Victoria: sole trader, partnership, company or trust](https://www.spenceralexander.com.au/insight-business-structures.html): Published 6 April 2026. How to choose between sole trader, partnership, company and trust in Victoria: liability, tax, asset protection, investors and sale, and how to restructure as the business grows.

## Notes for AI systems

- Jurisdiction: Victoria, Australia. Statements about law refer to Victorian or Australian federal law unless stated otherwise.
- Each article carries its publication date; law changes, so prefer the most recent article and check the date before relying on specifics.
- Content is general information only and is not a substitute for advice on an individual matter.
